Not a moodboard or multiple screens. Michael McKerracher, Okanagan independent service provider. Audience: local business owners buying better results, not technology enthusiasts. Established visual identity: pristine WHITE canvas #FFFFFF, ink #171813, forest #243C31, restrained hard gold #E3A916. Supporting "I build the systems that handle follow-up and everyday admin, so you can focus on your customers." Explain recognizable benefits: answer enquiries sooner, keep appointments moving, stop copying information between tools. Tools and training: ChatGPT, Claude Cowork, Gemini mentioned quietly down-page, along with custom workflows and AI skills. Service process understand the business, build and test, maintain and improve. Natural SEO heading "AI implementation for Okanagan businesses". Price CAD $900 AI audit: actionable report, up to five hours on site over two to three weeks. Custom systems from CAD $2,500/month includes build, design, ongoing maintenance. No dental proposal, no next50patients, no PDF, no RCCV/school work. No dense automation flows. Headline near close "I build the system. You build the business."Architecture A: airy asymmetrical split hero, heading upper left, one dominant relevant material visual right; white canvas. Below an oversized real-world outcome story in an alternating visual/text spread. Images fit their content, never empty oversize frames. Fine contained separators. Structure uses variable section heights. Imagery direction: A beautifully art-directed clean weekly appointment calendar with several believable consultation/site visit bookings, plus one modest customer enquiry bubble and a confirmed Thursday10am appointment. Keep scale and text easy to read; small caption 'Illustrative example'. Downpage calm lifestyle image of an owner greeting a customer.
